description: This file contains a SwiftUI extension for `CronSettings` that defines the user interface for managing cron jobs and their related interactions, such as creating, deleting, and viewing job details within a macOS application.

methods.name: var body
methods.description: Defines the main UI layout for the `CronSettings` extension, managing the display of header, banner, job list, and detail views, as well as handling user interactions like editing, deleting, and refreshing jobs.

methods.name: var schedulerBanner
methods.description: Displays a warning banner if the cron scheduler is disabled, providing information and optional store path details.

methods.name: var header
methods.description: Provides the header section with title, description, and action buttons for refreshing and creating new jobs.

methods.name: var content
methods.description: Main content area showing job status/error messages, job list with context menu, and details for selected jobs.

methods.name: var detail
methods.description: Displays detailed information and run history for the selected job, or instructional text if no job is selected.
